queries.query: "Large Language Models" OR "LLM" AND ("network operations" OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR "network change")
queries.rationale: Capture primary work applying LLMs to NetOps tasks (config generation, change planning, troubleshooting) to map the phenomenon and recent empirical studies.

queries.query: LLM hallucination OR "erroneous output" OR "incorrect output" AND (operations OR NetOps OR "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Survey known failure modes of LLMs when applied to operational artifacts, to characterize the phenomenon of incorrect/unsafe outputs in NetOps contexts.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-verify-repair" OR "generate-validate" AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "foundation model") AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Locate architectures that pair generative models with validators/repairers—central to mitigations and tooling for NetOps safety.

queries.query: "network configuration verification" OR "network verification" OR Batfish OR Veriflow OR "Header Space Analysis"
queries.rationale: Collect formal/deterministic verification tools and methods used to validate configs and define operational correctness metrics (reachability, loops, ACL compliance).

queries.query: "tool-assisted" OR "tool use" OR ReAct OR Toolformer OR "tool-augmented LLM" AND (operations OR NetOps OR "network troubleshooting")
queries.rationale: Find methods where LLMs call deterministic tools or external validators to improve correctness—relevant mechanism for safe agentic workflows in NetOps.

queries.query: AIOps OR NetOps benchmark OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "OpsEval" OR "OWL" OR dataset AND (network OR configuration OR topology)
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation suites to assess benchmark validity and identify gaps for operational evaluation in NetOps.

queries.query: "intent-based networking" OR IBN OR "intent-to-configuration" OR "natural language to config"
queries.rationale: Locate work on translating operator intent (NL) to configuration artifacts and associated validation/constraint mechanisms—important operational framing and metrics.

queries.query: metrics OR "operational correctness" OR "reachability" OR "policy compliance" OR "loop-freedom" AND (network OR configuration OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Assemble literature defining concrete operational metrics and validators that map to safety/reliability claims for generated configurations.

queries.query: adversarial OR robustness OR "adversarial configuration" OR perturbation AND (network configuration OR NetOps OR "LLM-generated")
queries.rationale: Survey adversarial threats and robustness analyses relevant to LLM-proposed NetOps actions and deterministic validators' sensitivity to malformed/surprising inputs.

queries.query: "agentic" OR autonomous agent OR "autonomous agent" AND (NetOps OR network OR "operational agent" OR "agentic workflow")
queries.rationale: Gather work on autonomous/agentic systems applied to operations, orchestration frameworks, and safety/guardrail approaches for end-to-end agentic NetOps tasks.

queries.query: "human-in-the-loop" OR "human oversight" OR "operator-in-the-loop" AND (AIOps OR NetOps OR "LLM")
queries.rationale: Find empirical/organizational studies on integrating human oversight with automated NetOps tools to measure mitigation effectiveness and workflow feasibility.

queries.query: "synthetic network dataset" OR topology generator OR Mininet OR ns-3 OR "network dataset" AND (dataset OR benchmark)
queries.rationale: Identify common synthetic and simulated environments and datasets used to evaluate NetOps tools and LLMs, for reproducible experiment design and external validity checks.

queries.query: "benchmark validity" OR "construct validity" OR "external validity" OR "criterion validity" AND (benchmark OR evaluation)
queries.rationale: Retrieve methodological literature on benchmark validity and best practices to assess whether NetOps benchmarks measure operational safety/reliability appropriately.

queries.query: prompting strategies OR "constrained decoding" OR "specification language" OR DSL AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Collect techniques (constrained generation, domain-specific languages, structured output methods) that reduce invalid outputs for config synthesis and increase verifiability.

queries.query: "configuration repair" OR "rollback planning" OR "change validation" OR "intent validation" AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Locate operational workflows and automated repair/rollback mechanisms relevant for mitigation and failure recovery of LLM-generated changes.

inclusion_criteria: English-language scholarly publications (peer-reviewed conferences or journals) and arXiv preprints with complete bibliographic metadata
Tool and verifier documentation (Batfish, Veriflow, Mininet, ns-3) and released GitHub repos/datasets with clear provenance
IETF drafts/RFCs and industry whitepapers documenting operational practices or intent-based networking
Papers and reports from 2010–2026 where foundational (network verification) or recent (LLM/AIOps) relevance is clear
exclusion_criteria: unverifiable sources lacking authors, date, or venue (anonymous blog posts) unless they are official vendor/tool documentation
opinion pieces without empirical or methodological content unless they provide operational context from vendors (label as industry commentary)
works outside the topic family (non-network operational domains) unless they provide generalizable methods for LLM safety/verification that are directly applicable
date_rationale: Primary coverage window: 2018–2026 to capture the rapid emergence of LLMs and recent AIOps work. Include earlier seminal network-verification and formal-methods literature (circa 2000–2017) selectively to establish validators and operational correctness concepts. This balances contemporary ML advances with foundational NetOps verification research.
